newsitem.title: CHINA: Speculative attacks on HK dollar will fail - Tung.
newsitem.headline: Speculative attacks on HK dollar will fail - Tung.

text.p: Hong Kong leader Tung Chee-hwa said on Tuesday that speculators trying to attack the Hong Kong dollar are "bound to fail".

"We have such a good foundation. So if speculators want to make any attack on the Hong Kong dollar, they are bound to fail. We're very confident (about it)," he told reporters after a meeting with his cabinet.
He noted the territory is backed by China's econonomy and its reserves.
"As Asian currencies have been fluctuating and the world's stock markets have been correcting recently, Hong Kong as an international city of course will have ups and downs," he said.
"But as our foundation is so good, that definitely won't have a long-term impact," he said.
